record.edic_text:
3512 neoterikos {neh-o-ter'-ik-os}

from the comparative of 3501;; adj

AV - youthful 1; 1

1) peculiar to an age, of youth, youthful, younger
   1a) younger (than now)
   1b) young, youthful
   1c) younger (by birth)
   1d) an attendant, servant, inferiority in rank
